title: Original plan
detail: Coordinator plus 11 agents: Scribe; Readers A (company & accounting), B (people & law), C (Andersen, watchdogs & reform); Footnote Annotator; Story Writer; Reference Writer; Fact-Checker; Source Scout; Image Researcher & Diagrammer; Site Builder. Wave 1: Readers, Footnote Annotator, Images, Site skeleton in parallel, then Fact-Checker reviews fact cards. Wave 2: Writers, Scout, Images, Site in parallel. Wave 3: full fact-check with send-backs. Wave 4: assembly and testing. Only files flow between agents, always through the coordinator. Estimate 4-6 hours.

title: Plan change requested by the project owner before approval
detail: The site must work equally well on a computer (including projected in a classroom) and on a phone, not phone-first. Added: margin annotations on wide screens, a presentation (large text) mode, keyboard navigation, print-friendly chapters.

title: Step 0: fingerprint check
detail: Computed SHA-256 for every file in download_log.csv: 74 of 74 files match. Two manifest rows have no file, as expected: batson-2nd-interim and batson-3rd-interim.

title: Step 0: text extraction
detail: Installed poppler-utils (pdftotext) and Tesseract OCR from the Ubuntu package archive. Extracted page-marked text for every PDF and HTML source into work/text/ (sources/ untouched). Ten PDFs have no text layer (all Batson reports and appendices, and the Joint Committee on Taxation report); started OCR on the ones the plan needs: batson-final, batson-final-app-d, -app-a, -app-b parts 1-2, batson-1st-interim, rpt-jct-vol1. OCR text can contain recognition errors, so every quote from an OCR text must be checked against the page image.

title: Step 0: finding about andersen-scotus
detail: The library file for Arthur Andersen LLP v. United States (Cornell LII page) contains only the Syllabus, not the full opinion. The Syllabus is prepared by the Reporter of Decisions and is not part of the opinion. It is enough for the basic facts (indictment, jury verdict, Fifth Circuit affirmed, Supreme Court reversed) but citations must say Syllabus. Logged in gaps.md.

title: OCR speed fix
detail: First OCR run was extremely slow (about 2.5 minutes per page) because each OCR process tried to use every processor core at once. Limited each to one core; now about 2 pages per second across 4 cores.

name: Reader A: The Company & the Accounting
role: Pulls fact cards on the business, mark-to-market accounting, the SPEs, and the collapse

name: Reader B: The People & the Law
role: Fact cards on each person: role, allegations, and how their case ended

name: Reader C: Andersen, the Watchdogs & Reform
role: Fact cards on the auditor, document destruction, Big Five to Big Four, pensions, SOX and the PCAOB basics

name: Footnote Annotator
role: Annotates Note 16 of the 2000 Form 10-K phrase by phrase

name: Image Researcher & Diagrammer
role: Finds public-domain/CC images and draws original diagrams; keeps the credits file

name: Site Builder
role: Builds the static site: design, pages, shared code

name: Scribe
role: Keeps the build log (log.json and log.js) from the coordinator's notes

what: Briefs work/briefs/01-07 plus common rules 00; text copies in work/text/
